snippet.title: Yeshanagula | The Paradise | Nani | Keerthy Suresh | Anirudh Ravichander | Srikanth Odela

snippet.title: FEAR FACTORY - Roboticist (OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO)
snippet.description:
Industrial metal pioneers @fearfactorymusic launches a bold new era with "Roboticist," — the latest single marks the recording debut of the band's current lineup featuring vocalist Milo Silvestro, drummer Pete Webber, and bassist Tony Campos. Blending crushing mechanical aggression with a haunting, melodic hook, the track explores a dystopian reality where flesh fails and only consciousness endures.

"The future isn’t coming. It’s already here, ‘Roboticist’ is the next evolution of Fear Factory.
Man, Machine and the war for what comes next. I can’t wait for everyone to hear the beginning of a new era of Fear Factory."
Dino Cazares

Produced, engineered, mixed, and mastered by Damien Rainaud, the single arrives alongside a cinematic music video directed by Vincente Cordero and produced by Arion Csihar. System activated: the next chapter of FEAR FACTORY has officially begun.

snippet.title: 'AFTER IMPACT' Official Trailer (2026) | Post-Apocalyptic Sci-Fi | @FreestyleDigitalMedia
snippet.description:
'AFTER IMPACT' is a 2026 post-apocalyptic sci-fi thriller directed by Michiel Rensen, available on Digital September 15 via Freestyle Digital Media.

When his father dies, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country. But any hope of a new beginning disappears when the world learns that an asteroid is on a collision course with Earth.

As society begins to unravel, Ethan faces betrayal, isolation and the growing fear that surviving may cost him everything that makes him human.

He retreats to his family's bunker and waits out the impact.

What comes afterwards may be even worse.

Injured and completely alone, Ethan endures the slow grind of days without another person to speak to as despair begins to close in.

Then his radio crackles to life.

A faint voice breaks through the silence — and everything Ethan believed about being alone changes.

'AFTER IMPACT' is a haunting sci-fi thriller about isolation, endurance and the fragile hope that someone else may still be out there.

Directed by: Michiel Rensen
Starring: Michiel Rensen, Maxie Li, Riki Antonievich, Will Clague, Stephanie Ramlose, Lee-Ann Dirks, James Crompton, Moehau Hodges-Tai, Lisa Zhang, Karlton Laing, Carolyn Deng, Radostin Radev

snippet.description:
Twelve years in the making. Your first look is finally here.

This is Ithaqua: the wind with teeth.

A remote 1800s fur-trade outpost is plagued by an ancient evil with an insatiable hunger for flesh. The cold is the least of anyone's problems…

Directed by Casey Walker and starring Luke Hemsworth, Leenah Robinson, Kevin Durand, Craig Lauzon and Michael Pitt. This is a haunting folk horror experience where isolation, hunger and myth collide.

Hammer Presents is proud to bring Ithaqua to UK screens, premiering at FrightFest this weekend, ahead of its full release in early 2027.

snippet.title: What Happens When Joe Satriani Joins Mick Jagger? | “Start Me Up” Live 1988
snippet.description:
What Happens When Joe Satriani Joins Mick Jagger? | “Start Me Up” Live 1988

Filmed live at the Tokyo Dome in Japan, this historic concert captures Mick Jagger operating at the absolute peak of his stage energy. Backed by a phenomenal solo tour supergroup—featuring guitar hero Joe Satriani and legendary drummer Simon Phillips—Jagger electrifies over 50,000 fans with non-stop swagger and crowd-commanding charisma.

🚀 The Live Lineup:

🎤 Mick Jagger – Lead Vocals
🎸 Joe Satriani – Lead Guitar
🎸 Jimmy Rip – Guitar
🎸 Doug Wimbish – Bass Guitar
🥁 Simon Phillips – Drums
🎹 Phil Ashley – Keyboards
🎤 Syreeta Wright & Carol Kenyon – Backing Vocals

📋 5 Fast Facts About the Performance & Liner Notes:

• *The 1981 "Tattoo You" Anthem* – Originally released in August 1981 as the lead single for The Rolling Stones' album *Tattoo You*, "Start Me Up" reached #2 on the US Billboard Hot 100 and became the defining stadium opener for the band's 1980s era.
• *The Long-Awaited Japanese Debut* – Due to Japanese visa restrictions that blocked 1970s and 1981 tour dates, Jagger's solo performances at the Tokyo Dome marked the very first time Japanese audiences got to hear these 1981 Stones classics performed live by their original lead singer.
• *Virtuoso Guitar Support* – Fresh off his breakout instrumental solo album *Surfing with the Alien*, guitar hero Joe Satriani joined Jagger's touring lineup, bringing signature technical brilliance to Keith Richards' iconic 1981 open-G riff.
• *From Reggae to Rock* – The track originally evolved during the 1978 *Some Girls* sessions as a slow reggae jam named "Never Stop" before being rediscovered and re-recorded into a driving 1981 rock masterpiece.
• *Restored Vault Audio* – Sourced directly from original multi-track broadcast soundboard masters, this high-definition audio restoration isolates Jagger's vocals and Satriani's soaring solos in pristine clarity.

See you in the Arena!

snippet.title: Surviving Minecraft's Best Horror Mod
snippet.description:
Today I'm diving deep into The Broken Script, one of the strangest and most unsettling Minecraft horror mods I've ever played. What starts as a normal Minecraft survival world slowly turns into a corrupted Minecraft ARG filled with creepy entities, random events, impossible structures, hidden dimensions, glitches, world corruption, and things that feel like they absolutely should not be happening in Minecraft.

I played a ridiculous amount of The Broken Script to see just how far this mod goes. Unlike most Minecraft horror mods, The Broken Script is extremely unpredictable. Strange entities can appear in the distance, structures can suddenly generate around you, the world can change without warning, and the game itself can begin behaving like something is wrong with it.

If you like Minecraft horror, scary Minecraft mods, Minecraft ARGs,  cursed Minecraft, survival horror, mysterious entities, analog horror, liminal Minecraft, or heavily modded Minecraft, this is one of the wildest mods I've played.

snippet.title: GTA 6 is gunna be a problem…
snippet.description:
🐑 Become a sacrificial lamb. Join the News Daddy Patreon: https://patreon.com/DylanPage?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_fan&utm_content=copyLink

🎮 GTA 6 EXTENDED LOOK: TOP 10 FEATURES
We just got nearly 30 minutes of never-before-seen GTA 6 footage and boys, we are in big trouble, it looks that good. We run through the 10 most exciting things we now know: the insane graphics, the open-world mini-games, character physique that changes with workouts, an 80-hour playthrough, a choice-driven storyline where your actions carry weight, the Jason and Lucia relationship system, a map double the size of GTA V, over 600,000 NPC animations, advanced in-game social media, and confirmation of nearly every leak.

🕷️ ISHOWSPEED AS SPIDER-MAN?
A tweet caught my attention claiming Speed is set to play Miles Morales in Avengers Secret Wars. I dug into the source and got bad news, no credible outlet is actually reporting this, and the account behind it has a history of shitposting. But now the idea's in my head, I don't hate it. We get into why Speed can actually act, the open Miles Morales casting, and whether it'd be a good fit or ruin the character.

🌊 THE FULL NEPAL FLOOD DISASTER
Some of the most shocking footage I've seen in half a decade of covering news. Entire villages, bridges and buildings were consumed after flash flooding triggered an enormous mudslide in Nepal, with boulders the size of buildings swept along in the current. We cover the scale of the devastation, the more than 1,300 missing, the rescue effort, and the freak chain of events behind it: a collapsing glacier that registered as a 5.2 magnitude earthquake, and the bigger question of why it happened and whether more are coming.

📱 META GETS AWAY WITH IT AGAIN
Remember the $1 trillion lawsuit that could have forced Instagram and Facebook to end infinite scroll, ditch stories and make their algorithms less addictive? Meta just settled for $17 billion, less than 20% of their annual revenue, and avoided going to court to face the evidence. We get into how the early settlement came about, the minor changes they actually have to make, and why it feels like they paid their way through the justice system.

⚖️ UEFA PREPARES CRIMINAL ACTION AGAINST INFANTINO
While the US states settled, UEFA absolutely refuses to let FIFA president Infantino off the hook. Reports say UEFA is preparing criminal legal proceedings over his plans to sell off stakes of the World Cup to private investors. At this point it's hard to see how FIFA survives the next four years to the next World Cup.

🔒 THE TATES BEG TO AVOID PRISON
Andrew and Tristan Tate are in bigger trouble than ever. They appeared in a Florida court shackled in jail uniforms, with Tristan complaining he's lost weight and calling the conditions "death by scurvy," begging to be released on bail to fight extradition to the UK, where 59 charges could keep them locked up for life. We get into the flight-risk arguments over their multiple passports and why it's not looking good for them.

🕊️ A WEEK OF DEVASTATING LOSSES
So many public figures passed away this week. We pay respects to legendary Hollywood stunt performer James Lew at 73, Dolly Parton at 80, Tim Curry (Pennywise in the original It and The Rocky Horror Show), Peter Cullen (the voice of Optimus Prime), and King Harald V of Norway, Europe's oldest reigning monarch, at 89.

📜 TODAY IN HISTORY: AUGUST 29
Our recurring segment returns. We get into August 29th through history: Michael Jackson born in Gary, Indiana in 1958; Netflix launching in 1997 by mailing DVDs (sharing a birthday with the King of Pop before it became the king of streaming); the first Guinness World Records book in 1955; and Martin Luther King Jr's "I Have a Dream" speech delivered to over 200,000 people.

snippet.title: SOCIETY 100% // HARDEST LEVEL
snippet.description:
Download Asphalt Legends for free here: https://gmlft.co/PACMANxZOINK
Use code ASPHALTPACMAN for a free in-game bonus.
The PAC-MAN event is live in Asphalt Legends until September 15th.

Society is an interesting level which I have finally completed, through the pain of high cps and tight timings, this actually fits my skillset much better then many other levels in the top 5.
Society being the first top 3 to be verified with cbf, the difficulty of the level was definitely not held back at times. However, this level is still quite unbalanced but it is very approachable.
Not much more needs to be said, was difficult but was able to pull it off! Thanks for all the support and I hope we can continue to push forward towards the human limit.

snippet.description:
Widely regarded as the most successful region in international VALORANT competition, VCT Americas is home to world-class talent, championship-winning veterans, and the latest generation of emerging stars. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, Verizon, and Zowie.

snippet.title: Can You Beat Borderlands 4 With Only Pearls?
snippet.description:
I still did less splashzone runs than people that wanted a crit knife

Uploads Whenever
Twitch Channel - https://www.twitch.tv/1altered

Music Used In Video (In Order)
Resident Evil 4 Remake - The Drive
Super Mario Odyssey - Steam Gardens
Napple Tale Arsia In Daydream - A Guitars Rhythm
Legend Of Zelda Breath Of The Wild - Yiga Clan Base
Pokemon Platinum - Cynthia's Theme
We Ski - Slideshow
Super Smash Bros - Waluigi Pinball
Sega Marine Fishing - The Offing
New Super Mario Bros - Luigi's Casino
Clair Obscur Expedition 33 - Monoco's Theme
Mario Kart 8 - Mute City

More Borderlands Videos
https://youtu.be/KtUD8adID7w
https://youtu.be/3KawunAjmjE
https://youtu.be/2fdPyZ4SjgI
https://youtu.be/SiD_j4iaS5M

Intro Script for algorithm stuff
It has been 14 years, 3 mainline games and 3 spinoff titles since Pearls have officially been in any borderlands game. For reference the last time pearls were in a borderlands game I was 8 years old. That’s how many thousands of subs I am away from 100k (please subscribe) It has been 14 whole years since you could get a super rare gun just to be disappointed by it. But all of that changed earlier this year when they were finally added back to the franchise in borderlands 4 alongside the bounty of the stone demon dlc. So i’m gonna try to beat borderlands 4 with only pearls. Now you obviously know that this is possible, which means you’re probably here for one of three reasons. You wanna know how long it took, you wanna see some pearl drops and my reactions to it, or you just wanna watch me shred some of this game's bosses.

But Before I can do any of that, I need to get one, I’m playing Cash for this run he’s got one of the best action skills for the early game when i’ve got no gear and i’ve also never played him before, starting off i breeze past the prison break without any issues and kill warden scathe pretty quickly, next i end up on the beach with claptrap, who gives me my next objective, to kill splashzone which I will be doing A LOT.

Let me explain. Borderlands 4 has a ton of pearls with different sources that each can come from, some are dedicated drops, others come from ordonite processors, and 8 of them can world drop, i’m going for one of those, Splashzone is by far the quickest and easiest loot source for me to kill gearless over and over and that’s how im gonna get my first pearl, by farming splashzone for however long it takes i wonder how many times i’ll level up before i get one
